dataset_id: 1549,comparison=отчетный период к соответствующему периоду прошлого года
methodology: Index, same month of the previous year = 100 -- so 112.6 means 12.6% annual inflation. This is the headline inflation rate. The existing CPI series carries only month-on-month change, from which this cannot be derived; both come from the same open-data file, which has a comparison-type dimension with thirty values. Independently consistent with the NBK-sourced ANNUAL_INFLATION series.
